lines.1: That night, we were hanging out as usual.
lines.2: 「I'm still jealous of that couple we saw today. I want a woman of my own, damn it.」
lines.3: 「Hey, why don't we have a contest? First one to get a girlfriend wins. Gives us something to shoot for.」
lines.4: 「No way. That makes it sound like a footrace.」
lines.5: 「Hmm... Okay, June's almost here, which means summer, right? Whoever gets a girlfriend this summer and makes the rest of us jealous wins.」
lines.6: 「And what exactly does the winner get?」
lines.10: 「I just want to see what you'd look like swept up in romance, Leo.」
lines.13: 「You're against getting carried away by some passing rush, aren't you?」
lines.14: 「...Nothing good ever comes of it. That crap belongs in middle school.」
lines.15: 「If you let the heat of the moment take over... sometimes everything you've built up can burst apart.」
lines.16: That's right... It only takes a moment for things to break.
lines.18: 「So I live neither too hot nor too cold. Neutral.」
lines.20: 「But don't you want to get closer to the Princess?」
lines.27: 「You're not exactly fired up about this, are you?」
lines.28: 「With Subaru acting like that, I feel like this might end without a winner.」
lines.32: Would having one make every day more fun?
